decisions.evidence: Fresh inventory found five PTY value payloads with a closed runtime-free public dependency graph: builtins plus PtySpec -> PtySize. The values own no process, descriptor, callback, runtime, or lifecycle resource, so value-protocol stabilization is technically coherent without stabilizing PtyRuntime. However, current governance classifies the whole PTY family as experimental pending independent production and cross-platform evidence; terminal_lab is a feature demo, recommended examples and principal consumers have zero PTY API dependency, and four focused tests emphasize runtime integration rather than freezing each exact value shape. Current docs describe PTY integration as experimental while stable Command/Event already expose the five concepts. Phase 4E authorization was explicitly narrow and does not authorize removal or payload replacement for these stable enum constructors. Therefore Phase 5A does not promote payloads, contract cases, reclassify Command/Event, or hide the exact debts. Stable and experimental contracts remain unchanged and all five debts remain machine-visible pending an explicit owner choice to guarantee the current value model or authorize a future stable contraction boundary.

decisions.evidence: Fresh member, call-chain, consumer, test, documentation, and transitive-closure census found a mature bounded producer contract inside the existing EXPERIMENTAL ExternalPort. tryEnqueue is mutex-linearized and returns exactly Accepted, Full, or Closed; Accepted means insertion plus a visible empty-to-nonempty wake when required, not App.update completion or durable delivery across shutdown. Runtime import is FIFO and run-to-completion; close is idempotent, rejects later enqueue, and clears accepted but not-yet-imported work. agent_tui constructs ExternalPort<Event>, uses it across producer threads as a single-flight mailbox wake marker, and runs it through App.runWithExternalPort; normal production does not use eventSource, state, drain, size, or lifecycle-barrier methods, while conditional performance tracing uses counters only as diagnostics. eventSource is runtime waiter integration over EXPERIMENTAL EventSource; state returns INTERNAL RuntimeState and has no external caller. The review therefore authorizes Phase 5C-I to harden the existing type under EXPERIMENTAL policy, internalize runtime-only members, separate diagnostics through existing member-tier governance, freeze direct concurrency/close/wake semantics, include a stable App integration path, and only then stabilize ExternalPort plus ExternalEnqueueResult. It rejects a second sender/channel facade and dependency promotion. Production/classification/contracts stayed unchanged; API fixtures and deterministic checks, architecture/fitness validators, core 515/515, agent_tui 65/65, agent_app 15/15, 17 example builds/smokes, pressure/permanent gates, and the original-workspace canonical-SDK current official release gate passed.
decisions.revisit: Implement S0/S1/S2 hardening and stabilization in Phase 5C-I; keep EventSource EXPERIMENTAL, RuntimeState INTERNAL, debt zero, and Focus Management plus VirtualTranscript in the portfolio backlog.

decisions.evidence: S0 retained the mixed EXPERIMENTAL ExternalPort contract. Three direct tests froze default/positive/invalid capacity, two concurrent producers with per-producer order and exactly-once resident entries, and idempotent close with accepted-before-close discard plus post-close Closed.
